ios.desc:
In My Pocket is your offline space for documents, files and notes. Bring PDFs, photos, ideas and everyday lists together in one place on your device.

ORGANIZE YOUR EVERYDAY FILES

• Store documents, PDFs, photos and videos

• Write notes with Markdown formatting

• Create checklists and keep track of things to do

• Save audio recordings with text transcription

• Arrange your content in custom tabs and sections

FIND AND USE WHAT YOU NEED

• Capture photos with the camera and copy text from images

• Copy information quickly and generate QR codes

• Set reminders for important dates

• Find your content through iOS search

• Use optional Apple Intelligence suggestions for text and tab organization

ALL OFFLINE

Your content is stored locally on your device and is available without an internet connection. No account is required to organize and consult your files and notes.

EXPORT AND IMPORT UNDER YOUR CONTROL

Use encrypted export and import to create a backup or move your content between your devices. You choose when to export and where to keep the resulting file.

Created by an independent developer. Have a suggestion or found a problem? Get in touch: your feedback helps improve In My Pocket.

show_hn.title: Show HN: In My Pocket – An offline personal data vault

quotes.text:
I built a privacy-focused iOS app to solve a personal frustration: the constant hunting for information like bank details, loyalty cards, and documents that we need to access regularly.

In My Pocket is designed with these principles:

- Complete data privacy: Everything stays on your device
- No internet connectivity required
- No cloud syncing/storage
- Support for text, images, and PDF documents
- Biometric security for sensitive information
- OCR functionality to extract text from images and PDFs

Tech details:
- Built with SwiftUI
- Uses local device storage only
- Implements biometric authentication
- Features document categorization with tabs and sections
- PDF rendering and text extraction capabilities
- QR code generation for sharing

I built this primarily for myself but thought others in the HN community might find it useful, especially those concerned about privacy. It's available on the App Store.

I'd appreciate any feedback or suggestions for improvement.
